brand.name: PMR Digital Marketing Agency
brand.tagline: Your Growth Deserves More Than Ordinary Marketing.

theme_strategy.marketing_website: Dark hero with violet & deep indigo gradients, glassmorphism floating nav, glowing coral CTAs, transition into light crisp editorial sections for deep case study reading.
theme_strategy.saas_dashboard: Premium Dark SaaS Studio (#0B1020 background, #13192E surface, #1E2640 subtle borders). Densified data, vibrant status badges (Lime/Cyan/Coral), multi-view project/task systems.
theme_strategy.client_portal: Isolated executive dashboard view with simplified ROI metrics, project milestone tracker, deliverable approval cards, and direct message channel.

hierarchy.h1_hero: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-extrabold tracking-tight leading-[1.1]
hierarchy.h2_section: text-3xl sm:text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-bold tracking-tight text-white

layout_and_grids.marketing_bento: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-8 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-6 lg:gap-8
layout_and_grids.dashboard_grid: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4 md:gap-6

public_website: Header with glassmorphism blur, Brand Logo, Nav links, Strategy Call CTA button
Hero Section with headline 'Your Growth Deserves More Than Ordinary Marketing', animated stats ticker, floating strategy preview badge

9 Core Services Showcase: SEO & Organic Search, Performance Ads (PPC), Social Media Mastery, Content Strategy, Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO), Web & App Engineering, Email & Automation, Brand Identity, Data & Analytics
6-Step Growth Methodology Engine: Audit & Insight -> Strategy Blueprint -> Omnichannel Execution -> Data Analytics -> CRO Optimization -> Scale & Expand
Filterable Portfolio Bento Grid with real client metrics (+340% ROAS, 12x Revenue Increase)
Target Industry Tabs (Startups, E-commerce, Real Estate, Healthcare, Education, MSMEs)
Interactive Strategy Booking Dialog / Lead Generation Form
Insights & Blog section with search & topic tags
Footer with Hyderabad office details, newsletter signup, quick links, and social channels
saas_dashboard: Sidebar Navigation with role selector (Admin / Agency Manager / Team Member)
Overview Dashboard: Revenue charts, active leads count, ongoing project statuses, team capacity, task throughput
CRM & Lead Management Kanban pipeline (New, Contacted, Proposal Sent, Negotiation, Closed Won, Lost)
Client Directory with detailed health scores, retainer contracts, and quick portal links
Project Tracker: Table view, Kanban board, timeline view with budget burn rate
Task Kanban System with priority tags, assignees, deadlines, subtasks
Content Calendar Planner with social platform tags & approval workflows
Financials & Invoicing: Status badges (Paid, Pending, Overdue), PDF generator trigger, payment links
Files & Asset Management: Shared creative assets, brand guidelines, campaign decks
Analytics Reports Generator with export capability
client_portal: Client Dashboard: Key campaign KPIs (ROAS, CPL, Organic Traffic, Impressions)

motion_and_interactions.modal_transitions: AnimatePresence with opacity and scale spring animation

testing_attributes.rule: Every button, link, tab, input, dialog, card, and table row MUST include data-testid attribute in kebab-case format.

instructions_to_main_agent: Execute full component architecture in React .js files.
Implement navigation switching between Public Website, Agency Admin Dashboard, and Client Portal seamlessly.
Ensure the hero uses dark violet/indigo/coral gradients with glowing highlights.
Do NOT rely on generic default styling — use custom Tailwind color values provided in this config.
Include sample data for CRM, projects, content calendar, and invoices to make the platform feel like an active, lived-in SaaS product.
Add interactive elements: Lead calculator, Kanban drag-and-drop or column movement, filtering tabs, interactive strategy booking modal.
